name: PillarPlan: Even Spacing Guide
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
works: Client planner for evenly spaced pillars: P adds the aimed block as a path point, G/K widen/tighten the gap, C arms a curve, U undoes, O clears; each step answers on the action bar ('[PillarPlan] ...') and the planned pillars are outlined in the world.
note: Not yet: P is also Horizon's social-interactions key, which opens its screen even in single player (the try closes it with Escape); the key names on its messages show as key.keyboard.p (Kiln doesn't translate key names yet); the pillar outlines (Gizmos.cuboid) aren't drawn.
